from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from pydantic import BaseModel
from wasmtime import Store, Module, Instance

router = APIRouter(prefix="/wasm/plugins")

class WasmInvocationRequest(BaseModel):
    input_payload: str

@router.post("/{plugin_id}/run")
async def run_wasm_plugin(
    plugin_id: str,
    req: WasmInvocationRequest,
    plugin_store: WasmPluginRegistry = Depends(get_wasm_plugin_registry),
    user: AuthUser = Depends(get_auth_user)
):
    wasm_plugin = await plugin_store.get_plugin_bytes(plugin_id)
    if not wasm_plugin:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="WASM plugin not found")

    if wasm_plugin.organization_id != user.organization_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, detail="Access denied to requested WASM plugin")

    store = Store()
    module = Module(store.engine, wasm_plugin.bytecode)
    instance = Instance(store, module, [])
    run_func = instance.exports(store)["execute"]

    output = run_func(store, req.input_payload)
    return {"plugin_id": plugin_id, "output": str(output)}
